about_the_game:
Dive into the City of Pando with this demo for Vita: The Ember Oracle, the third game in the Vita Series!

Get hands-on with the new combat system, mastering skill equipping and management. This demo thrusts you into a thrilling segment of the story, complete with intriguing Side Quests, impactful Side Story Events, and a taste of the game's most intense narrative moments.

Play your way with full support for Xbox controllers, Mouse & Keyboard (MnK), or dedicated Mouse-only and Keyboard-only controls.

Important: This demo features pre-set characters and no save points; progress will not transfer to the full game.

Enjoy your journey through the vibrant world of Atria!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGL/CRAM 1gb or better
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x720 display or better
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon 580 or Better
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x720 display or better
